description: The entrance foyer makes a strong design statement with a translucent backlit marble panel. A geometric gold-framed mirror and a sleek console table enhance the luxury and brightness of the transitional space.

altText: Powder room featuring Italian marble wall cladding, a floating wooden wash vanity, and a backlit round mirror.
description: This compact powder room utilizes premium materials to maximize impact. Large-format Italian marble walls are paired with a floating wooden vanity and a large circular mirror with soft halo backlighting.

altText: Balinese-themed show flat living room with low-slung teak sofas, woven cane ceiling panels, and tropical potted plants.
description: This show flat living room showcases organic Balinese resort living. Low-slung wood sofas with neutral linen cushions sit beneath custom cane-paneled ceilings, surrounded by tropical indoor palms that enhance the relaxed, earthy mood.

altText: Dining space featuring a rustic solid teak dining table, chairs with woven rattan backrests, and suspended wicker pendant lamps.
description: The dining zone utilizes organic textures, featuring a live-edge teak dining table and matching rattan chairs. Large woven wicker pendant lights hang low over the table, casting warm, textured light patterns across the room.

altText: Master bedroom suite with a custom teak platform bed, a woven cane headboard, and sliding wood louver doors.
description: This resort-style master bedroom centers on a low platform bed with a custom cane headboard. Sliding wood louver doors separate the room from the wardrobe, allowing natural light and air to flow freely.

altText: Kitchen showcasing warm wood grain laminate cabinets, black granite countertops, and open wooden shelves with ceramic pottery.
description: The kitchen design blends functionality with natural textures, featuring rich wood grain cabinets and a durable black granite countertop. Open wooden shelves showcase artisanal ceramic plates and mugs, matching the Balinese design theme.

altText: Spacious balcony verandah with a bamboo screen ceiling, wicker daybed with white cushions, and potted tropical plants.
description: An outdoor terrace designed as a Balinese daybed lounge. A bamboo-slat screen ceiling filters light over a cozy wicker daybed, surrounded by terracotta pots filled with tropical plants, creating a private outdoor oasis.

altText: Cozy guest bedroom with textured sandy plaster walls, wood bed frame, and woven cotton throw blankets.
description: This guest bedroom showcases earthy minimalism, pairing raw sandy textured plaster walls with a simple teak wood bed. Cream and beige woven textiles provide soft layer details under dim, warm bedside lights.

altText: Study area featuring a clean teak writing desk, a leather-backed chair, and wooden bookcases holding decorative artifacts.
description: The home office area offers a quiet workspace surrounded by natural textures. A solid teak desk and leather chair sit before custom open shelving displaying books and Balinese decorative carvings under warm lighting.

altText: Modern bathroom displaying light grey terrazzo tiles, teak floating shelves, and a round mirror with a woven rope frame.
description: This master bathroom integrates modern cleanliness and organic textures. Speckled grey terrazzo wall tiles form a clean backdrop for floating teak storage shelves and a circular mirror framed in hand-woven rope.

altText: Double-height entrance foyer with a sleek black console table, large abstract canvas art, and polished granite floors with brass strips.
description: The grand foyer creates a dramatic entrance with its soaring double-height ceiling and polished granite flooring with decorative brass inlay. A minimalist black console and a large abstract painting add modern artistic details.

altText: Contemporary living room with a grey fabric sectional sofa, a tan leather lounge armchair, and a bookmatched marble TV wall.
description: This main living area exemplifies contemporary luxury, utilizing a clean grey sectional sofa and a classic tan leather armchair. A massive wall clad in bookmatched white and grey marble forms the main architectural focus.

altText: Formal dining area featuring a long white quartz table, grey fabric chairs, and a linear minimalist black chandelier.
description: The dining space is designed for elegant entertaining, centering on a sleek, long quartz dining table. Modern grey fabric chairs and a linear black chandelier above create a clean, contemporary silhouette.

altText: Cozy family lounge with a dark blue sectional sofa, warm oak wood wall paneling, and integrated bookshelves.
description: A comfortable secondary lounge space designed for family gatherings. A deep blue sectional sofa is set against warm oak wood wall panels with custom built-in bookshelves, offering a cozy and relaxing atmosphere.

altText: Master bedroom suite with a king bed featuring a charcoal leather headboard, a textured concrete accent wall, and walk-in wardrobe.
description: The master bedroom showcases industrial contemporary style, contrasting a soft charcoal leather headboard against a raw concrete-textured wall. The layout flows into a semi-open custom walk-in closet.

altText: Dedicated home theatre room featuring soundproof acoustic wall panels, plush leather recliners, and fiber-optic starry ceiling.
description: This private home cinema is engineered for premium acoustics and comfort. Flanked by textured acoustic fabric panels and equipped with deep leather reclining chairs, the room is crowned by a custom fiber-optic 'starry sky' ceiling installation.

altText: Luxury master bathroom with white statuario marble walls, a double floating wash vanity, and glass-enclosed shower.
description: A bright, spa-like master bathroom finished completely in white statuario marble. A floating wooden double vanity, chrome fixtures, and a seamless glass shower screen maintain a clean, luxurious aesthetic.

altText: Grand double-height living room featuring massive abstract canvas art, custom designer furniture, and architectural light sculptures.
description: This celebrity-scale double-height living area represents dramatic modern luxury. Soaring walls display massive abstract art canvases, while custom-designed furniture and sculptural pendant lights create a high-fashion architectural gallery.

altText: Sophisticated bar and dining area showcasing a backlit white onyx bar counter, luxury bar stools, and views of a private pool.
description: The entertainment zone centers around a glowing backlit onyx bar counter paired with sleek designer bar stools. The dining and bar area features floor-to-ceiling glass windows that open directly onto a private outdoor pool deck.

altText: Ultra-luxurious bedroom suite featuring a king bed with silk wall upholstery, a designer vanity, and automated window tracks.
description: This opulent master suite features walls padded in premium cream silk upholstery, framing a grand custom bed. A dedicated designer vanity desk and automated curtains add convenience and high-end hotel luxury.

altText: Villa living room with a high-pitched wooden ceiling, exposed teak columns, and comfortable linen-covered couches opening to a courtyard.
description: This Yeoor villa living space captures classic Balinese pavilion architecture. High-pitched timber ceilings and massive teak pillars frame a relaxed seating lounge, while wide sliding glass doors open directly to a tranquil central courtyard.

altText: Open-plan dining area and kitchen with custom warm timber cabinets, solid wood dining table, and hanging wicker lamps.
description: The villa's open kitchen and dining area showcase seamless rustic detailing. Custom teak wood cabinets and a raw-edge dining table are highlighted by hanging wicker basket lamps, creating a warm, organic gathering space.

altText: Master bedroom suite featuring a solid wood canopy poster bed, a textured stone accent wall, and wooden floor boards.
description: A rustic, resort-like master suite highlighting a solid timber four-poster canopy bed. A rough-cut natural stone feature wall and wide-plank wood flooring emphasize the villa's earthy Balinese aesthetic.

altText: Neoclassical living room displaying white wall panels with classical moldings, crystal chandeliers, and velvet armchairs with gold trims.
description: This elegant neoclassical salon showcases refined white wall moldings and highly polished marble flooring with black borders. Sparkling crystal chandeliers and custom velvet armchairs with golden accents evoke timeless European luxury.

altText: Elegant dining room with a carved mahogany dining set, a large gold-leaf gilded wall mirror, and classical wall sconces.
description: The formal dining space features neoclassical symmetry, centering on a rich carved mahogany dining table and matching chairs. A large gilded mirror sits above the buffet counter, reflecting the light of ornate brass sconces.

altText: Master bedroom with a high tufted headboard, neoclassical wall moldings, and warm ambient cove lighting.
description: The master bedroom suite showcases luxury, pairing a high tufted velvet headboard in champagne tones with crisp neoclassical wall paneling. Hidden LED cove lighting casts a soft, warm wash across the ceiling.

altText: Neoclassical guest bedroom featuring soft pastel pink and grey details, custom wall panels, and white shaker wardrobe doors.
description: This delicate guest room combines neoclassical detailing with a modern pastel color palette. Custom wall moldings frame the bed, while white shaker-style wardrobe doors provide clean, architectural storage.

altText: Kitchen showcasing classic white shaker-style cabinets, a white marble backsplash, and solid brass drawer hardware.
description: The kitchen is designed in a timeless shaker style, featuring white paneled cabinets and solid brass hardware. A bookmatched white marble backsplash adds a layer of modern luxury to the highly functional culinary space.

altText: Study room featuring dark walnut wood bookcases, a leather writing desk chair, and warm library-style lighting.
description: Designed as a classic home library, the study features custom floor-to-ceiling bookcases in a rich dark walnut finish. A comfortable leather armchair and dedicated task lighting create a focused environment for reading and work.

altText: Elegant bedroom showing a beige fabric headboard, matching silk curtains, and neoclassical nightstands with gold accents.
description: A sophisticated guest suite featuring matching beige silk drapery and custom nightstands. Neoclassical wall moldings and subtle gold trims coordinate to deliver a cohesive, premium guest experience.

altText: Outdoor balcony lounge with comfortable weather-proof seating, a white marble balustrade, and ocean views.
description: This private balcony lounge overlooks the ocean, featuring classic neoclassical marble balustrades. High-end weather-resistant armchairs offer a comfortable spot to enjoy the panoramic views.

altText: Powder room with a classic gilded vanity mirror, marble inlay floor pattern, and decorative glass wall sconces.
description: The powder room showcases detailed neoclassical luxury, highlighting a polished marble inlay floor. An ornate gilded wood mirror vanity and decorative glass sconces create a sparkling, high-contrast vanity space.

altText: Modern living room displaying a minimalist low TV console, Italian marble floor, and comfortable beige sectional sofa.
description: This contemporary living area is designed for spacious minimalism, featuring polished Italian marble flooring. A low-profile wooden TV console and a deep beige sectional sofa create a clean, modern family room.

altText: Dining space featuring a sleek rectangular glass table, modern grey dining chairs, and large wall mirror panels.
description: The dining room utilizes mirrors to expand the visual space, pairing large floor-to-ceiling mirror panels with a minimalist glass dining table. Modern grey upholstered chairs complete the clean, contemporary dining zone.

altText: Master bedroom featuring a grey and white color palette, a custom platform bed, and sliding dark glass wardrobe doors.
description: The master bedroom showcases clean lines and a modern monochrome palette. A low custom bed is set against a fabric accent wall, flanked by a wardrobe featuring large dark glass sliding doors.

altText: Modular kitchen with matte grey and white acrylic cabinets, light quartz countertops, and stainless steel hardware.
description: This highly efficient modern kitchen features a high-contrast layout of matte grey and white acrylic panels. White quartz countertops and integrated stainless steel handle profiles maintain a sleek, clean workspace.

altText: Vibrant children's bedroom featuring a modern wooden bunk bed with integrated storage drawers and a custom study desk.
description: This children's room is optimized for learning and play, showcasing custom light oak joinery. A modern bunk bed features integrated steps and drawers, paired with a matching study desk under colorful shelves.

altText: Cozy balcony featuring artificial green turf flooring, a small round table with two chairs, and privacy planters.
description: This high-rise apartment balcony is designed as a relaxing outdoor lounge. Artificial turf flooring is paired with a minimalist bistro dining set, while tall privacy planters create a green, secluded escape.

altText: Modern bathroom displaying dark grey stone wall tiles, a floating vanity cabinet, and clean chrome bathroom fittings.
description: This master bathroom features modern slate-grey tiles and clean chrome hardware. A floating wood vanity with a ceramic wash basin maximizes floor space, creating a clean, architectural powder room.

altText: Cozy lounge corner featuring a modern high-back accent armchair and a minimalist metal book rack.
description: A quiet reading nook carved out of the bedroom corner. A modern high-back armchair in a warm charcoal weave is paired with a sleek black metal bookshelf, offering a cozy private retreat.
